description: Frederik Hendrikbuurt 1885-1890 four-storey front (Houweningenstraat, Van Reigersbergenstraat, Frederik Hendrikstraat 134-154): red-brown brick, 3 axes on ~4.7 m, tall two-light windows with white frames under flat arches of five white blocks (tall/short alternating, windowSurround jack-blocks; round 2 drew small dentil teeth), a white band through the piers at the transom line, black iron anchors on the piers, white cornice with consoles, ground storey with a pair of red doors beside a wide window; crowns: one white pediment dormer over the centre axis, sometimes a pointed brick gable with one attic light. Drafted by typeDraft.ts from 57 pands, authored from the strips.

match.note: houweningen-1-31, houweningen-2-38, reigersbergen-1-37, hendrik-134-154 strips (2021-2022); 3DBAG eaves 13.5-14.0 m

pediment-dormer.note: houweningen-1-31 and hendrik-134-154: one white pediment dormer with a finial over the centre of nearly every pand; dormerBody timber (painted white, as the clercq types): with stone the dormer glass had no host wall (houweningen-2-38-r1 opening-outside, 4 dormers, 4.4 m2)

point-gable.note: pointed brick gable with one attic light; strips houweningen-1-31 2021-02-22 (pands 15/31 at px 1704-1892 and 3208-3396), hendrik-134-154 2022-04-29: apex 17.1 m over the ground against 3DBAG eaves 13.7 m, 3.4 m = 1.15 upper storeys of 2.95 m (was 2.6, read as metres: crownRise is in upper-storey heights, so it drew 7.5 m)

roof.evidence: strips 2021-03/2022-04: over the cornice only the dormers and gables stand against the sky; dark slate band behind (hendrik-134-154)
